$comment: Expected validation outcome for every fixture in this directory.
This file is the single source of truth for two consumers: the Node check
ManifestValidationTest in the control plane. If those two ever disagree
about what a bad manifest produces, one of them is wrong and this file
stage: 'schema'   - rejected by JSON Schema validation.
stage: 'semantic' - passes JSON Schema, rejected by the normalizer.
pointer          - RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the submitted document.
keyword          - the constraint that failed, as reported by the validator.

unknown-api-version.yaml.why: An unrecognised apiVersion selects no schema, so nothing else can be checked.

invalid-service-name.yaml.why: The name becomes a DNS label and a metrics prefix.

tier-out-of-range.yaml.why: Tier drives every conditional policy rule; there is no tier 5.

unknown-property.yaml.why: A misspelled key must be reported rather than silently dropped.

missing-environments.yaml.why: A service that declares nowhere it runs cannot be observed.

bad-slo-window.yaml.why: The window must be whole days so the error budget can be computed.

slo-target-one-hundred.yaml.why: A 100% target has no error budget and no alertable threshold.

duplicate-environment.yaml.why: JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness by a child property, so the normalizer checks it and points at the duplicate rather than at the array.
